moc_hoi: must show: old London Bridge with houses and an open gap; must NOT show any dome or modern bridge
canh: London Bridge on the evening of 2 September 1666: the fire stops at the gap
loi_cau: London Bridge survives. A gap left by an earlier fire, in 1633, stops the flames from crossing to Southwark. Instead, the wind drives the fire west, along the waterfront, and up the hill.
mo_ta: Cầu London Bridge trong trận Đại hỏa hoạn năm 1666 với khoảng trống ngăn đám cháy lan sang bờ Southwark.
